purpose: Compare the actual symbol maps and structural headers emitted for the full eight-DOF M5/Bakken tax-zero NLP under the same sort-symbols request.
conclusions: The two environments construct identical named variable, constraint, and objective component sets for this NLP.
Constraint and objective ordering is identical, but variable ordering differs immediately after an eleven-variable prefix; only 780 of 5,555 variables retain the same column position.
The largest variable displacement is 2,460 columns and occurs in an R102 reactor outlet state variable, placing the strongest reordering directly in the unit implicated by the ill-conditioned solve.

Pyomo 6.10.1 emits thousands of common-expression records that Pyomo 6.4.2 does not, reducing the NL file to about one quarter of its historical size despite identical reported NLP dimensions and nonzero counts.

The full-DOF cross-version convergence difference is therefore consistent with writer-level column ordering and expression grouping changing IPOPT's numerical path; it is not evidence that named model equations or components changed. This diagnosis does not by itself establish which writer representation is numerically preferable.
